newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Carlsberg Malaysia in Sri Lanka project.
newsitem.headline: Carlsberg Malaysia in Sri Lanka project.

text.p: Carlsberg Brewery Malaysia Bhd said on Monday it has signed a memorandum of understanding to invest in a brewery project in Sri Lanka.
It said in a statement on Monday that its participation in the project would be through a proposed 24.6 percent stake in Lion Brewery Ceylon Ltd, to be established by Ceylon Brewery Ltd.
The shares to be acquired by Carlsberg are part of an initial share offer by Lion Brewery totalling 50 million 10 rupees shares at 20 rupees each.
Lion Brewery will set up a brewery near Colombo, with an initial installed capacity of 300,000 hectolitres.

Total cost of the project is estimated at 75.0 million ringgit, with Ceylon Brewery to contribute 25.2 million ringgit and Carlsberg 12.3 million. The rest will be raised through a public share issue and institutional financing.

Carlsberg said its proposed investment in the project, to be financed from internal funds, would enable it to broaden its earnings potential and utilise its surplus funds in a related business activity in the region.
